generation.design: Exactly two separate upright alpha silhouettes, each with a real exposed jagged edge, half the medallion and half the bottom button. No drawn crack or runtime polygon seam.
generation.registration: Separate generated silhouettes at 686px visible height, y=30 in individual 1000x750 transparent canvases. Left outer edge x=20; right outer edge x=980.

motion.inscription: No inscription during ascent or fall. Existing target realm success heading and prose fade onto the fragments only after floor impact, masked by each fragment's actual alpha.
motion.failureMessage: Original failure consequence in black text centered on screen, revealed after fragments settle.
motion.confirmation: Click during motion reveals final result without confirming.
motion.reducedMotion: Show final broken result and failure message immediately.
